name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (architect → explore → design) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (direct Sonnet worker dispatch per layer wave, executed red-check) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.38.0 — the replay harness's scratch worktree stops leaking its own provenance to the blind reviewer (specs/20260826/01-replay-scratch-path-blindness.md). `replay.js --setup` now derives `{dir}` itself from the target spec (`merge-back.sh branch-for`'s build-worktree stem, `/`→`-`, plus a random 6-hex suffix) instead of doctrine handing sessions a `.claude/worktrees/replay-<random>` example to paraphrase; `replay.md` describes the derivation and never supplies a copyable name. A supplied `--dir` whose basename opens with `replay` (case-insensitive) is now refused outright (exit 3, remedy: omit `--dir` and pass `--spec`), mirroring the existing commit-subject refusal. The private-git-dir marker is renamed `replay-worktree` → `scratch-worktree` everywhere it's planted, guarded, or read (`replay.js`, `block-cross-worktree-writes.sh`, `replay.md`). Caveat: the six `stage:"replay"` ledger rows recorded before this fix were measured under a path tell — real observations, but not proof blindness held; the defensible catch rate starts at the first row after this spec's close. 7.37.2 — consultant discovery: the genesis interview stops being a scripted lens-batch script and becomes adaptive (specs/20260825/02-genesis-consultant-discovery.md). The one fixed structure is a silent **coverage audit** over ten business/legal/product keys the model cannot derive (`payer`, `tenancy`, `data-sensitivity`, `residency`, `ai-use`, `unattended`, `integrations`, `scale-outage`, `vendor-budget`, `offline-mobile`), recorded in `.claude/genesis/brief.md`'s `## Coverage` block and asked in plain language wherever dark; the hard-to-reverse dimension set now also derives six keys from those answers (`tenancy-model`, `data-residency`, `llm-provider`/`vector-store`/`eval-harness`, `data-in-training`, `background-jobs`, `observability`, `api-versioning`) on top of the archetype registry floor. **The brief is the interface**: authored from the new `spec/templates/genesis-brief.md` (six fixed sections), re-rendered and printed to the console after every answer — the old read-back sign-off gate is gone. A throwaway `.claude/genesis/sketch.html` checks understanding as soon as a core screen is named, pruned at `/spec:genesis-design` lock. Every `wf-research` menu option now carries `because` (the coverage answers behind its rank) and `priced` (a consequence at the brief's stated scale) as required schema fields; `genesis-architect.md` and `genesis-design.md` build every `AskUserQuestion` description from `tradeoff` · `because` · `priced` · recency. 7.37.1 — review-fix on specs/20260825/01: the retired genesis panel's last references are cleared from the one workflow that survived (`wf-research.js`'s `meta.description` and its dissent-flag comment) and from `genesis.md` § Genesis: Executed Assumptions. The AC-20260825-01-2 literal ban gains bare `panel` and extends its sweep to `wf-research.js`, closing the blind spot that let these through — `pipelineOwnedPaths` (`spec/workflows/wf-*.js`) prunes that file from collision-closure's literals leg and scope-reconcile alike, so the enumerated-file test is the only gate that can see it.
